summary: The build is on track for Botswana (30 November to 3 December). Your WhatsApp business account has been set up on Meta, and your new number is ready on the borrowed phone. We will walk you, Grant and Lez through the platform on 11 November.

updates.text: Your question about keeping guest details longer: yes, partly. With each guest's agreement, basic contact details (name, organisation, email, WhatsApp number and language) can be kept for future events. Passport copies and dietary and accessibility details are still deleted after each event. This is noted for after Botswana, and nothing changes for Botswana.

Your new WhatsApp number works on the borrowed phone, so no eSIM change is needed and your own phone stays as it is. Your Melted Workx business account is set up on Meta, with you invited as an admin. The data agreement has been emailed to you for signature. Shuttle messages will use a simple shuttle list that Lez uploads.
Your website is live with everything Meta needs. Thank you, Grant.
Walkthrough booked for Wednesday 11 November at 10:00 on Google Meet. Grant is needed for the first 20 minutes only.

Both Botswana registration forms are ready, approved by OSF, with the tick box for travel messages. Local guests will not be messaged, so their form stays as it is. SMS messages will go through Clickatell, a South African provider.
Agreed: guests register for Botswana on your Google Form as usual, with one added tick box so they agree to receive WhatsApp and SMS messages about their travel.

Received your iPad details, your company documents for the WhatsApp approval, your Cape Town shuttle list and the headings of your registration sheet. For practice we use a scrambled copy of the Cape Town list, so no real guest details are shared.
Cape Town dates received (14 to 19 November). We will use them for a quiet practice run alongside your own process.
Event dates received: Botswana, 30 November to 3 December, with accreditation on 1, 2 and 3 December. Logos received. Manual check-in by name, without a scan, is planned for the day.
Project approved. Planning complete and the build team is set up. Registration and event setup come first.

questions.q: Can we keep guest data longer than one year, so returning OSF guests don't have to give their details again?
questions.a: Yes, partly. With each guest's agreement, we can keep name, organisation, email, WhatsApp number and language for future events. Passport copies and dietary and accessibility details are still deleted after each event, because the law treats them as sensitive. Please check with OSF that they are happy for Melted Workx to keep their delegates' details. After Botswana, Deon will send a short proposal for a returning-guest list, with a small update to the data agreement.

change_requests.status: Noted for later. For Botswana, guests upload their passport on your Google Form as usual.
